extracted.name: Cold Noodle Salad
extracted.description: Our Cold Noodle Salad recipe is hearty, bright, and full of fresh veggies. We like to add our favorite protein, like shrimp, chicken, or tofu.
ingredient_lines: 8 oz lo mein noodles or Pancit noodles*
½ cup cashews or peanuts (, roughly chopped )
2 cups cooked rotisserie chicken (, shrimp, steak, or tofu (optional))
instruction_lines: Cook noodles according to package instructions. Drain and rinse with cold water. Toss in a little sesame oil, so they don’t stick, while they cool.
Dressing: Whisk all dressing ingredients together then set aside.
Assemble: Add all salad ingredients to a large bowl and toss to combine. Add noodles and half of the dressing and toss to combine. Add more dressing as needed, to taste.
